_comment: The content-gap register's settings (brief §73), read by tools/make_register.py, the Pages tab and the Ask bar alike. min_asks_month: a page enters the retrieval list when typed questions named it this often in a month; min_answers: a page enters the content list when this many answers cited it in the period; statuses: the fixed list the status file may use; owners: who the evidence and status files belong to. stale_before: a cited page last changed before this date is stale. retrieval_not_found / retrieval_reached: a named page enters the retrieval list when its not-found share is at least the first, or when the page or a sibling in its category was cited in under the second of the questions naming it. kinds missing-page and signpost (brief §75) are topic rows with no URL: a subject with no page, or one the site will never carry where the right answer is an organisation; their evidence comes from register-themes.json until the topic layer computes it. topic_min_turns / topic_not_found / topic_partial (brief §75): a lexicon topic with that many typed questions in the period enters as missing-page at that not-found share, or as detail at that partial share. page_partial: a cited page enters the detail list when this share of its answers (and 1.5x the typical share) said something was missing. archive_patterns (brief §103): regexes on a cited page's address; with year_before_data the pattern's first group is a year, and the page is an archive page when that year is before the data's year (past Budgets); an archive page cited in min_answers+ answers is raised as archive-cited for the AskCI team and is never stale or detail. stale_partial_ratio / stale_unmatched / stale_min_checkable: a page last changed before stale_before is stale only with a sign of a problem, a partial share at least stale_partial_ratio x the typical share, or stale_unmatched+ of its stale_min_checkable+ checkable figures on no cited page; an old page with neither is written as kind old, outside the register. rising-failing (brief §104): a topic among the ten fastest risers by share, latest complete month against the one before, whose not-found share is topic_not_found+.

owners.status: the analyst until a content-side owner is named
